name: story-root
comment:scripts: Every service is a workspace with its own config, so every service script here is a passthrough and the root has no Vite of its own (§7). `dev:multi-engine-server` has no `build` sibling on purpose: the node server runs its TypeScript directly under `tsx`, no build step and no `dist/` (§7). Parallel `dev` orchestration and `test` are Phase 11.

scripts.build: yarn typecheck && yarn workspace @story/single-engine build && yarn workspace @story/visualizer-client build && yarn workspace @story/multi-engine-client build

comment:dependencies: A real workspace root: tooling only (§7). Every runtime dependency now sits in the workspace that imports it. `react`/`react-dom` are not listed here — they are declared by the two apps at an exact version and pinned once through `resolutions` below, which is what keeps a single copy on disk (§10 risk 3). Deleted in Phase 8 rather than moved: `d3`, `@types/d3`, `jlouvain`, `ngraph.forcelayout`, `ngraph.graph` — zero imports anywhere in the repo, they predate the refactor; and `vite-tsconfig-paths`, whose last consumer was the deleted root Vite config. `jsdom`/`@types/jsdom` stay pending the Vitest setup in Phase 10.
